propositions: module_size_trend and cap_change_events metrics are advertised but not implemented in git_metrics.py registry
Both metrics must walk date-filtered commit history, require at least two qualified revisions with valid cap and Python modules, and return Unavailable with specific reason if preconditions unmet
module_size_trend returns up to 50 evenly-spaced endpoint-inclusive samples of {sha, timestamp, cap, module_count, max_loc} computed by newline count from tracked blobs
cap_change_events compares adjacent qualified revisions and returns ordered {from, to, sha, timestamp} event pairs; no changes returns empty list not Unavailable
Existing dead-ID test must convert from deregistration assertion to live registered metric coverage; commit_cadence_trend remains held-out only
